common.tagline: Hindi to Mundari, for every classroom

home.heroTitle: Bring Class 1–5 lessons to life in Mundari
home.heroSubtitle: PalashVani helps Hindi-medium teachers in Jharkhand's PALASH schools translate everyday classroom Hindi into Mundari — with an honest confidence flag on every result, so nothing reaches a child unverified.
home.problemBody: Over 5,000 tribal-area primary schools teach in a language many children don't speak at home, and the teachers assigned to them are often Hindi-medium trained with no fluency in the local tongue.
home.solutionBody: Type, speak, or scan a page of Hindi text and get a Mundari result instantly — sourced from a verified dictionary first, with AI-assisted semantic matching only when needed, and never a silent guess.
home.howAiHelpsBody: A multilingual sentence-embedding model (MiniLM) recognises phrases that mean the same thing even when the wording differs — but every result still says exactly how it was produced: verified dataset match, fuzzy match, or AI-assisted.
home.featuresTitle: Built for the classroom, not a demo
home.feature1Body: Exact and fuzzy dataset matches are always tried before any AI-assisted guess.
home.feature2Body: Point a camera at a textbook page or speak Hindi aloud — both work without any paid service.
home.feature3Body: Browse the same verified phrases organised by Grade → Subject → Chapter.
home.feature4Body: Download a category for offline use — no connectivity needed in the classroom afterwards.
home.step2: Look for an exact dataset match
home.ctaSectionBody: No sign-up, no API key, no cost — just open the translator.

about.title: About & Confidence
about.subtitle: What PalashVani is, where its data comes from, and what the confidence flag means.
about.problemStatementBody: SIH26042: AI-Powered Vernacular Pedagogy and Real-Time Translation Tool for Mother Tongue-Based Primary Education, for Jharkhand's PALASH school network.
about.confidenceFlagBody: Every result is labelled with exactly how it was produced. A verified result comes directly from the curated dataset. An AI-assisted result is flagged so a teacher can decide whether to double-check it before using it with students. PalashVani never silently guesses.
about.limitationsBody: This prototype ships a small, hand-sourced demonstration corpus, not the full research corpus referenced in the original pitch. Text-to-speech for Mundari uses the closest available browser voice, which is an approximation, not a verified native recording. Browser support for voice input and speech output varies by device.
about.futureScopeBody: Ho and Santali support, a much larger verified corpus via formal partnership, a fine-tuned neural translation model, and offline speech synthesis are all natural next steps on this same architecture.
